title: Exponential envelope for a scaled expression
statement: For all natural numbers $C,c,K,r,s$, there exist natural numbers $A,e$ such that for every natural number $n$, $K\bigl(n+C\,(2^{s(n+1)})^c+1\bigr)^r\le A\,(2^n)^e$.
replaced: For all natural numbers $C, c, K, r$ and $s$ there exist constants $A$ and $e$ such that $K\,(n + C\cdot 2^{(s(n+1))^c} + 1)^r \le A \cdot 2^{n^e}$ for every natural number $n$.
